headline: American and Southwest report Q3 on Oct 22
summary: Both carriers hold third-quarter earnings calls the same day; United's Q3 filing is also still pending.

headline: Horizon pilots picket at Seattle and Boise
summary: Teamsters Local 1224, about 650 Horizon pilots, held informational pickets citing nearly four years of talks without a contract. Wages, staffing and training are at issue, along with the pay gap to Alaska mainline pilots flying similar work.

headline: Jet fuel roughly double a year ago
summary: Fuel was up about 102% year over year in mid-September. The largest carriers are absorbing it better on premium and loyalty revenue, while labor costs are rising in the same year and cannot be hedged.

headline: Delta cuts full-year outlook on fuel
summary: Delta lowered 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.10–$5.60 from $6.50–$7.50, citing roughly $6 billion in added annual fuel cost tied to US–Iran tensions. Premium revenue grew 18% in the quarter.

headline: PSA flight attendant talks hit a new obstacle
summary: AFA represents about 1,700 PSA flight attendants, who rejected a tentative agreement in March. Talks continue under the NMB with a session on Oct 23. PSA doubled the qualifying period for continuous medical leave to 14 days, effective Oct 12; pay, including when boarding pay starts, is the main open item.

headline: Boeing engineers ratify four-year contract
summary: SPEEA members approved a new Boeing agreement after rejecting the first offer in August, avoiding a strike.

headline: Alaska 737s begin Hawaiian interisland flying
summary: Alaska-branded 737-800s start on select Honolulu–Kahului frequencies in October. Hawaiian targets retiring its 717 fleet in 2028.

headline: Frontier reshuffles fleet, flags up to $200M in charges
summary: Frontier will replace 13 older aircraft and lease 10 new A321neos, following a July sale of 11 A321neos to Avolon.

headline: United beats Q2 but expects $6B more in fuel
summary: United topped second-quarter estimates while projecting about $6 billion in added fuel cost.

headline: Allegiant closes Sun Country acquisition
summary: The roughly $1.5 billion deal closed; the carriers run separately until the FAA issues a single operating certificate, and existing labor agreements are unchanged for now. Allegiant targets about $140 million in annual synergies within three years.

headline: Spirit Airlines winds down operations
summary: Spirit ceased flying after talks on a $500 million federal rescue stalled, following bankruptcy filings in November 2024 and August 2025.

headline: Republic and Mesa complete merger
summary: The combined company trades on Nasdaq as RJET with 310 E-Jets. Republic keeps its American, Delta and United capacity agreements; Mesa flies for United under a new 10-year deal.
